name: Mantova Wonderfest
blurb: Mantua's pop-culture fair for comics, retro gaming and cosplay; the convention formerly known as Mantova Comics & Games.
notes: This convention rebranded from 'Mantova Comics & Games' to 'Mantova Wonderfest' around 2022-2023 (kept the original batch id for stability since it is the same event/organizer, not a different con). The seed URL mantovacomics.it is now squatted by an unrelated app (a Tesla screen-mirroring tool, 'Car Cast'); the real current site is wonderfest.it, which as of this check is a placeholder ('Mantova Wonderfest is under construction' / 'aggiornamenti a breve') with no 2027 dates announced. The last confirmed edition ran June 2-4, 2026, already past the research window, so no edition is listed.
